title: Uptime Kuma
descript: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool: watch HTTP(s) services, TCP ports, ping, DNS, keyword checks and Docker containers, get notified through 90+ channels (Telegram, ntfy, email, webhooks) when something goes down, and publish a public status page. History and configuration stay in the application data folder.
release_note: 1. First release: Uptime Kuma 1.23.16 from Docker Hub as a non-root container. Uptime monitoring with status pages and 90+ notification channels; database in the application data folder.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Open the UI and create the admin account on first run, then add monitors and optionally notifications. The SQLite database lives in DockerAppData/uptimekumadocker/data. Plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before publishing the status page or exposing the admin UI to the internet.

wrapper_note:
the image entrypoint tries to chown its data folder, which fails in a non-root
container. This wrapper skips that step and starts the Node server directly; the
application still runs its own database migrations on start.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper**: the upstream entrypoint chowns `/app/data`; the wrapper starts `node server/server.js` directly as uid 1000 and lets the app initialise its database.

zh-cn.descript: Uptime Kuma 是自建的监控告警工具：监控 HTTP(s) 服务、TCP 端口、ping、DNS、关键字，甚至 Docker 容器；出问题时通过 Telegram、ntfy、邮件、webhook 等 90 多种渠道通知，还能发布公开状态页。历史与配置都保存在应用数据目录。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺失时应用中心会自动安装）。打开界面先创建管理员账号，然后添加监控项，按需配置通知渠道。SQLite 数据库保存在 DockerAppData/uptimekumadocker/data。界面为纯 HTTP，发布状态页或把管理界面暴露到公网前请配置带 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：基于 Docker Hub 的 Uptime Kuma 1.23.16，以非 root 容器运行。网站/服务监控，带状态页与 90+ 通知渠道；数据库保存在应用数据目录。

zh-hk.descript: Uptime Kuma 是自建的監控告警工具：監控 HTTP(s) 服務、TCP 端口、ping、DNS、關鍵字，甚至 Docker 容器；出問題時透過 Telegram、ntfy、郵件、webhook 等 90 多種渠道通知，還能發佈公開狀態頁。歷史與設定都保存在應用資料目錄。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。開啟介面先建立管理員帳號，然後新增監控項，按需設定通知渠道。SQLite 資料庫保存在 DockerAppData/uptimekumadocker/data。介面為純 HTTP，發佈狀態頁或把管理介面公開到互聯網前請配置帶 TLS 的反向代理。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：基於 Docker Hub 的 Uptime Kuma 1.23.16，以非 root 容器運行。網站/服務監控，帶狀態頁與 90+ 通知渠道；資料庫保存在應用資料目錄。

data_notes: `/app/data` (mounted from `DockerAppData/uptimekumadocker/data`) holds `kuma.db` (SQLite), uploaded icons and the Docker TLS certificates.
design_notes: **Direct node start.** The upstream entrypoint chowns the data directory; the wrapper skips that and runs `node server/server.js`, which still performs the database migrations.
**SQLite only.** No database server needed; monitoring history grows in the data folder.
limitations: - Monitoring runs from the NAS, so a NAS outage also stops the monitors.
- The admin UI is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.
- History grows over time; prune it in the UI or keep an eye on the data folder size.
